case: a file_set: an obj, its mtl, two textures — found by following references
why: The folder does not delimit the asset: the members are what the entry point calls (mtllib, then map_* with their options, a file name with a space included). A texture nobody calls stays out and is named. The digest is members_digest of the list.

model.obj.text:
# a triangle
mtllib model.mtl
v 0 0 0
v 1 0 0
v 0 1 0
vt 0 0
vt 1 0
vt 0 1
usemtl stone
f 1/1 2/2 3/3

model.mtl.text:
newmtl stone
Kd 1 1 1
map_Kd textures/stone_diffuse.png
map_Bump -bm 0.5 textures/stone normal.png
